definitions.terminalEncounter: All recorded turns whose floor equals the actual final run.floor, including failed encounters before floor12.
definitions.unit: Shared seed is the independent cluster. Sum numerators and instance-turn denominators across all included policies with that seed/outcome, calculate one rate per eligible seed, then report the equal-seed mean and Student-t 95% interval.
definitions.outcomes: Victory/defeat are descriptive post-outcome subsets, not causal card effects. all includes every completed campaign.
definitions.instances: All recorded instances are pooled, including normal, temporary and commission instances. Frozen campaign records omit their status/UID, so permanent-only rates cannot be reconstructed.
definitions.damage: Recorded own character-source damage only, including ordinary attacks and declared character attacks. Shared item/resonance/synergy damage is excluded. Support damage can legitimately be zero.
definitions.support: healing is actual source-attributed HP restoration; shieldGenerated is generated shield, not proof that it was used. GrowthLevel is retained growth level at that instance turn, not growth newly granted.
definitions.denominators: perAppearance uses present instance turns and only their outputs/levels; perHeldInstanceTurn includes all held instance turns, with absent instances retained as zero output. Missing exposure gives null mean/CI, not zero.
definitions.pooled: pooledPerAppearance/pooledPerHeldInstanceTurn are exposure-weighted descriptive point rates, separate from the equal-seed estimates/intervals.
definitions.final12: Optional floor12 outcomes keep non-reachers as zero in perCampaignAllSeeds. Per-appearance/per-held rates remain conditional on actual exposure.
